name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '27' is the dispatch-table index 0x27 (xref site 0x51c2d), a domain ID, not an address residue. Descriptor corrected from '__unref_drop' to '__ch15_eye_gem_drop': the slot is LIVE, reached via the ch15 kill-drop path -- ch15 char_spawn_record[58] = an orc (enemy_data 34, char_id 0x66, lv19) carries pickup_kind=2 param=0x27, so its death dispatches consequence[0x27], granting the plot gem item 0xD3 (魔眼寶石/光之眼) and showing the plot-reveal dialog page 0xB. The earlier 'unref' verdict only scanned turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed the kill-drop path.
purpose: Chapter 15 plot-gem drop (per-event dispatch slot 0x27, reached via the ch15 kill-drop path when the orc record[58] enemy_data 34, pickup_kind=2 param=0x27, falls): grant battle-drop item id 0xD3 (魔眼寶石/光之眼) to the recipient/killer char (dialog only shown if that char is on the player team), then display dialog page 0xB (the plot reveal) from the current chapter text.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x34) stack-probe prologue (PUSH ESI/EDI, 4-byte local slot). Inline-copies the 3-byte drop-entry blob at 0x52742 ({0x00,0xD3,0x00} = type 0 ITEM, value 0x00D3 = item id 0xD3) into a local via MOVSW+MOVSB, then calls fd2_process_battle_drop_entries(stepping_char_id, 1, &local) which, for a type-0 entry, only opens the drop dialog when pCharArray[recipient].bTeam==2 (player team) and otherwise returns having consumed the entry. Finally calls fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=0xB, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1). Straight-line, no branches, no RNG, no numeric computation; both call return values discarded. The function body 0x34F74-0x34FCA also hosts two shared epilogue tails reused by other handlers (code-folding artifact): alt_43 @ 0x34FB7 (PUSH chapter_text; CALL display_dialog; ADD ESP,0x24; cleanup; RET) consumed by handlers 0x29 and 0x33 (verified via xrefs), and alt_51 @ 0x34FC5 (ADD ESP,4; POP EDI; POP ESI; RET cleanup-only) consumed by handler 0x37 (verified via xref).
